requirement_text: Students added to a cohort shall be eligible for the cohort’s Program of Study.
user_story: As a registrar, I want students added to a cohort to be eligible for the cohort's Program of Study, so that they follow the right program.
technical_task: Make students added to a cohort eligible for the Program of Study of that cohort.
acceptance_criteria: Given a student added to a cohort, when the addition is saved, then the student is eligible for the cohort's Program of Study.
Given a student not in the cohort, when eligibility is checked, then the student is not made eligible through the cohort.
rationale: Role assumed: registrar. The garbled apostrophe in the source was read as "cohort's".

requirement_text: All management software functions shall take optimal advantage of all language, compiler and system features and resources to reduce overheads to the minimum practical level.
clarification_questions: What counts as "optimal advantage" and the "minimum practical level" of overhead?
Which language, compiler and system features are meant?

requirement_text: The Disputes application shall manipulate and view business data. Users will not have direct access to data files or databases.
requirement_text_raw: The Disputes application shall manipulate and view business data. Users will not have direct access to data files or databases.'
user_story: As a data owner, I want users to work with business data through the Disputes application only, so that nobody touches the data files or databases directly.
technical_task: Let the Disputes application manipulate and show business data and deny users direct access to data files and databases.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user of the Disputes application, when the user works with business data, then the data is viewed and manipulated through the application.
Given a user, when the user tries to open the data files or databases directly, then access is denied.

requirement_text: System shall provide information and tools for users to specify security measures for data.
user_story: As a user, I want information and tools to specify security measures for my data, so that I can protect it as I choose.
technical_task: Provide information and tools that let users specify security measures for their data.
acceptance_criteria: Given the security settings, when the user opens them, then information about the available security measures is shown.
Given the tools, when the user specifies a security measure for data, then it is saved and applied to that data.
rationale: Role assumed: user. Which measures exist is not stated.

requirement_text: The administrator will be able to view system statistics and generate reports based on selected criteria.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to view system statistics and generate reports based on selected criteria, so that I can monitor the system.
technical_task: Provide a statistics view and report generation filtered by criteria the administrator selects.
acceptance_criteria: Given the system has recorded activity, when the administrator opens the statistics, then system statistics are shown.
Given selected criteria, when the administrator generates a report, then the report is based on those criteria.

requirement_text: System shall communicate with the database via a wireless Ethernet system.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the system to communicate with the database over a wireless Ethernet system, so that it needs no cable.
technical_task: Connect the system to the database through a wireless Ethernet system.
acceptance_criteria: Given the wireless Ethernet system is available, when the system needs data, then it communicates with the database over it.
Given the system's configuration, when it is reviewed, then the database connection uses the wireless Ethernet system.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. The reason (no cable) is inferred.

requirement_text: System shall send a message to the main developer team if the serial key is invalid.
user_story: As a developer on the main team, I want a message when a serial key is invalid, so that I am told about invalid key attempts.
technical_task: Send a message to the main developer team whenever an invalid serial key is detected.
acceptance_criteria: Given an invalid serial key, when it is entered, then a message is sent to the main developer team.
Given a valid serial key, when it is entered, then no such message is sent.
rationale: Role assumed: main developer team member.

requirement_text: System shall be able to provide a list of the 3 nearest sites, sorted alphabetically by name, with links to their respective pages.
user_story: As a visitor, I want a list of the 3 nearest sites sorted alphabetically by name with links to their pages, so that I can open them.
technical_task: List the 3 nearest sites in alphabetical order by name, each with a link to its page.
acceptance_criteria: Given the visitor's position, when the list is requested, then the 3 nearest sites are shown.
Given the 3 nearest sites, when they are listed, then they are sorted alphabetically by name and each has a link to its page.

requirement_text: 100% of all search queries for reservations by user shall be from logons of only management logons.
user_story: As a manager, I want all search queries for reservations by user to come from management logons only, so that user data stays restricted.
technical_task: Allow reservation searches by user only from management logons, so that 100% of such queries come from them.
acceptance_criteria: Given a management logon, when it searches reservations by user, then the search is performed.
Given a logon that is not a management logon, when it searches reservations by user, then the search is refused.
rationale: Role assumed: manager. The 100% figure is covered by the second criterion.

requirement_text: System shall authenticate users using Django's authentication module and session-based authentication.
user_story: As a user, I want to be authenticated through Django's authentication module with session-based authentication, so that I stay logged in during my session.
technical_task: Use Django's authentication module and session-based authentication to authenticate users.
acceptance_criteria: Given valid credentials, when the user logs in, then the user is authenticated through Django's authentication module.
Given a logged-in user, when the user makes further requests in the session, then the session-based authentication keeps the user authenticated.

requirement_text: The system shall function on a processor with a minimum clock speed of 1.6 GHz.
user_story: As a user, I want the system to work on a processor with a minimum clock speed of 1.6 GHz, so that I can run it on modest hardware.
technical_task: Support processors with a clock speed of at least 1.6 GHz.
acceptance_criteria: Given a processor running at 1.6 GHz, when the system is run, then it functions.
Given a processor running above 1.6 GHz, when the system is run, then it functions.

requirement_text: System's back-end databases shall be encrypted to protect customer data.
user_story: As a customer, I want the back-end databases encrypted, so that my data is protected.
technical_task: Encrypt the back-end databases.
acceptance_criteria: Given customer data in a back-end database, when it is stored, then it is encrypted.
Given the database files, when someone reads them without the key, then the customer data cannot be understood.

requirement_text: System shall require users to have Java plug-ins enabled and CSS functioning properly.
user_story: As a user, I want the system to require Java plug-ins enabled and CSS working properly, so that its pages work correctly.
technical_task: Require Java plug-ins to be enabled and CSS to function properly in the user's browser.
acceptance_criteria: Given Java plug-ins are enabled and CSS functions, when the user uses the system, then it works.
Given Java plug-ins are disabled or CSS does not function, when the user uses the system, then the user is told what is required.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The second criterion is an assumption about how the requirement is enforced.

requirement_text: The scheduler shall provide a method for a task to be scheduled as a 50 Hz "helper" task for source congruency input exchanges and voted output exchanges that starts in a particular minor frame but runs only during every 5th or 50th minor frame, effectively running at a lower, sub-rate, 10 Hz or 1 Hz, respectively.
requirement_text_raw: The scheduler shall [SRS042] provide a method for a task to be scheduled as a 50 Hz "helper" task for source congruency input exchanges and voted output exchanges that starts in a particular minor frame but runs only during every 5th or 50th minor frame, effectively running at a lower, sub-rate, 10 Hz or 1 Hz, respectively.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want a method to schedule a task as a 50 Hz helper task that starts in a given minor frame but runs only every 5th or 50th minor frame, so that it effectively runs at 10 Hz or 1 Hz.
technical_task: Provide a scheduler method for a 50 Hz helper task, used for source congruency input exchanges and voted output exchanges, that starts in a chosen minor frame and runs only during every 5th or 50th minor frame.
acceptance_criteria: Given a helper task scheduled to run every 5th minor frame, when the scheduler runs, then it executes at 10 Hz.
Given a helper task scheduled to run every 50th minor frame, when the scheduler runs, then it executes at 1 Hz.

requirement_text: The parameters logged includes user or system account ID date or time stamp event source IP address error or event code and type.
requirement_text_raw: The parameters logged includes user or system account ID  date or time stamp  event source  IP address  error or event code and type.
user_story: As a security auditor, I want the logged parameters to include the account ID, time stamp, event source IP address, and error or event code and type, so that events can be investigated.
technical_task: Log the user or system account ID, date or time stamp, event source IP address, and error or event code and type for each event.
acceptance_criteria: Given an event, when it is logged, then the user or system account ID and a date or time stamp are recorded.
Given an event, when it is logged, then the event source IP address and the error or event code and type are recorded.

requirement_text: The FDIR shall place all fault and recovery information in shared memory for inclusion in the frames that will be telemetred and recorded by the CTC.
requirement_text_raw: The FDIR shall (3.3.5.17) place all fault and recovery information in shared memory for inclusion in the frames that will be telemetred and recorded by the CTC.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want FDIR to put all fault and recovery information in shared memory for the frames the CTC telemeters and records, so that it appears in telemetry.
technical_task: Write all fault and recovery information into shared memory so it is included in the frames telemetered and recorded by the CTC.
acceptance_criteria: Given a fault or a recovery action, when FDIR handles it, then the information is placed in shared memory.
Given information in shared memory, when the frames are built, then it is included in the frames telemetered and recorded by the CTC.

requirement_text: System shall provide functionality to list all students enrolled in a particular year.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to list all students enrolled in a particular year, so that I can see each year's students.
technical_task: Provide a list of the students enrolled in a chosen year.
acceptance_criteria: Given a year, when the administrator requests the list, then all students enrolled in that year are shown.
Given a student enrolled in another year, when the list for a year is shown, then that student is not listed.

requirement_text: User shall search for locations using city names for weather information.
user_story: As a user, I want to search for locations by city name to get weather information, so that I can see the weather there.
technical_task: Offer a location search by city name that returns weather information.
acceptance_criteria: Given a city name, when the user searches, then the matching location is found.
Given a found location, when the user opens it, then its weather information is shown.

requirement_text: Communication services shall provide the capability to create "pipe"s which "broadcast" their messages to all virtual groups.
requirement_text_raw: Communication services shall [SRS069] provide the capability to create "pipe"s which "broadcast" their messages to all virtual groups.
user_story: As a software developer, I want communication services to create "pipe"s that "broadcast" their messages to all virtual groups, so that one send reaches every group.
technical_task: Let communication services create "pipe"s whose messages are "broadcast" to all virtual groups.
acceptance_criteria: Given a "pipe" created for broadcast, when a message is sent into it, then every virtual group receives the message.
Given several virtual groups, when a message is broadcast, then none of them is skipped.

requirement_text: System shall search for and display related FAQs based on user-entered keywords.
user_story: As a user, I want related FAQs found and shown from the keywords I enter, so that I get help quickly.
technical_task: Search the FAQs by user-entered keywords and display the related ones.
acceptance_criteria: Given keywords entered by the user, when the user searches, then related FAQs are displayed.
Given keywords that match no FAQ, when the user searches, then no FAQs are displayed.

requirement_text: User shall be able to save a document of similar size within 0.5 seconds.
user_story: As a user, I want to save a document of similar size within 0.5 seconds, so that saving does not interrupt me.
technical_task: Make saving a document of similar size take no more than 0.5 seconds.
acceptance_criteria: Given a document of similar size, when the user saves it, then saving completes within 0.5 seconds.
Given a save that takes longer than 0.5 seconds, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Similar size" refers to a reference size not given.

requirement_text: User shall be able to offer withdrawal transactions.
user_story: As a bank operator, I want to offer withdrawal transactions, so that customers can withdraw money.
technical_task: Provide withdrawal transactions for users to offer.
acceptance_criteria: Given an account, when the user offers a withdrawal transaction, then it is available for use.
Given an offered withdrawal transaction, when a customer uses it, then the withdrawal is carried out.
rationale: Role assumed: bank operator. "Offer" is read as making the transaction available.

requirement_text: User shall be able to search for a person by department.
user_story: As a user, I want to search for a person by department, so that I can find colleagues.
technical_task: Add a person search that filters by department.
acceptance_criteria: Given a department, when the user searches for people, then the people in that department are listed.
Given a department with no people, when the user searches, then the list is empty.

requirement_text: System shall log transaction IDs securely and update log files accordingly.
user_story: As a security auditor, I want transaction IDs logged securely and the log files updated accordingly, so that transactions can be traced.
technical_task: Write transaction IDs to log files in a secure way and keep the log files up to date.
acceptance_criteria: Given a transaction, when it is processed, then its transaction ID is added to the log file.
Given the log file, when an unauthorized user tries to read or change it, then access is denied.

requirement_text: All credit card information will be secured on the server and only accessible by authorized Izogn administrators. Information will be encrypted in the database.
requirement_text_raw: All credit card information will be secured on the server  and only accessible by authorized Izogn administrators.  Information will be encrypted in the database.'
user_story: As a customer, I want my credit card information kept on the server, encrypted, and accessible only by authorized Izogn administrators, so that it is safe.
technical_task: Secure credit card information on the server, encrypt it in the database and limit access to authorized Izogn administrators.
acceptance_criteria: Given credit card information, when it is stored in the database, then it is encrypted.
Given a user who is not an authorized Izogn administrator, when the user tries to access credit card information, then access is denied.

requirement_text: A sending HCP edits a previously created patient referral as long as the referral has not been viewed by the receiving HCP.
user_story: As a sending HCP, I want to edit a referral I created as long as the receiving HCP has not viewed it, so that I can correct it in time.
technical_task: Allow the sending HCP to edit a previously created patient referral until the receiving HCP has viewed it.
acceptance_criteria: Given a referral not yet viewed by the receiving HCP, when the sending HCP edits it, then the changes are saved.
Given a referral already viewed by the receiving HCP, when the sending HCP tries to edit it, then the edit is not allowed.

requirement_text: The patient or representative chooses one of these DLHCP and types the subject (up to 100 characters) and text of a message (up to 1000 characters) and clicks the send button.
requirement_text_raw: The patient or representative chooses one of these DLHCP and types the subject (up to 100 characters) and text of a message (up to 1000 characters)  and clicks the send button.
user_story: As a patient, I want to choose one of these DLHCPs, type a subject of up to 100 characters and a message of up to 1000 characters and click send, so that I can contact the provider.
technical_task: Provide a message form with a DLHCP selection, a subject field limited to 100 characters, a text field limited to 1000 characters and a send button.
acceptance_criteria: Given the message form, when the patient chooses a DLHCP, types a subject of up to 100 characters and a message of up to 1000 characters and clicks send, then the message is sent.
Given a subject longer than 100 characters or a message longer than 1000 characters, when the patient enters it, then the extra characters are not accepted.

requirement_text: The solution should implement a policy to encrypt backup and archival media; ensure that policies direct the user of encryption technologies of the appropriate strength.
user_story: As a security officer, I want a policy to encrypt backup and archival media with encryption of appropriate strength, so that backups stay confidential.
technical_task: Define and enforce a policy that requires encryption of backup and archival media and directs users to use encryption technologies of appropriate strength.
acceptance_criteria: Given backup or archival media, when it is created, then it is encrypted under the policy.
Given the policy, when it is reviewed, then it directs the use of encryption technologies of appropriate strength.
rationale: Role assumed: security officer. "Appropriate strength" is not defined.

requirement_text: The NTC and the contact wires must be protected against exhaust gases, fuel traces and oil by a closed housing.
user_story: As a hardware engineer, I want the NTC and the contact wires protected against exhaust gases, fuel traces and oil by a closed housing, so that they are not damaged.
technical_task: Enclose the NTC and the contact wires in a closed housing that protects them from exhaust gases, fuel traces and oil.
acceptance_criteria: Given the NTC and the contact wires, when the assembly is inspected, then they are inside a closed housing.
Given exposure to exhaust gases, fuel traces or oil, when the assembly is tested, then the NTC and contact wires are protected.

requirement_text: The FTSS software shall take at most 1 msec of a 50 Hz minor frame.
requirement_text_raw: The FTSS software shall (3.3.4.18) take at most 1 msec of a 50 Hz minor frame.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the FTSS software to take at most 1 msec of a 50 Hz minor frame, so that application tasks have time to run.
technical_task: Limit the processing time of the FTSS software to 1 msec in each 50 Hz minor frame.
acceptance_criteria: Given a 50 Hz minor frame, when the FTSS software runs, then it uses no more than 1 msec.
Given a measured use above 1 msec, when it is evaluated, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: The administrator has authenticated himself or herself in the iTrust Medical Records system (UC3).
user_story: As an administrator, I want to be authenticated in the iTrust Medical Records system, so that I can carry out administrative work (UC3).
technical_task: Require the administrator to authenticate in the iTrust Medical Records system before administrative use.
acceptance_criteria: Given an administrator with valid credentials, when the administrator logs in, then the administrator is authenticated in the iTrust Medical Records system.
Given an administrator who is not authenticated, when the administrator tries administrative work, then it is not allowed.
rationale: Role stated: administrator. The sentence states a precondition of use case UC3.

requirement_text: System shall use transaction management software (BMS version 2.0), card management software (CMS version 3.0), and Yamaha codecs.
user_story: As a system owner, I want the system to use transaction management software (BMS version 2.0), card management software (CMS version 3.0) and Yamaha codecs, so that its components are known.
technical_task: Build the system on transaction management software BMS version 2.0, card management software CMS version 3.0 and Yamaha codecs.
acceptance_criteria: Given the system, when its components are listed, then it uses BMS version 2.0 for transaction management.
Given the system, when its components are listed, then it uses CMS version 3.0 for card management and Yamaha codecs.

requirement_text: Perfective Maintenance: New features may be added post product delivery.
rationale: The sentence describes a kind of maintenance and states no system behaviour.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement or a description of the maintenance type?
Which new features may be added, and what must the system do to allow it?

requirement_text: Further details on proposed ADC and task timing and interrupt strategy is provided in the SWIO Specification.
rationale: The sentence only points to another document.
clarification_questions: What does the SWIO Specification say about ADC and task timing and the interrupt strategy?
Is the referenced document part of this requirement?

requirement_text: The Disputes application shall ensure that only authorized users are allowed to logon to the application.
requirement_text_raw: The Disputes application shall ensure that only authorized users are allowed to logon to the application.'
user_story: As a security officer, I want only authorized users to log on to the Disputes application, so that disputes data is protected.
technical_task: Allow logon to the Disputes application only for authorized users.
acceptance_criteria: Given an authorized user, when the user logs on, then access is granted.
Given a user who is not authorized, when the user tries to log on, then access is denied.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to create a presentation by adding slides, defining content, and applying formatting.
user_story: As a presenter, I want to create a presentation by adding slides, defining content and applying formatting, so that I can prepare my talk.
technical_task: Provide presentation creation with slide addition, content definition and formatting.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new presentation, when the user adds a slide, then the slide is added.
Given a slide, when the user defines content and applies formatting, then the content and formatting are saved.

requirement_text: The website shall be attractive to all audiences. The website shall appear to be fun and the colors should be bright and vibrant.
requirement_text_raw: The website shall be attractive to all audiences.  The website shall appear to be fun and the colors should be bright and vibrant.'
clarification_questions: What makes a website "attractive", "fun", "bright" and "vibrant" in measurable terms?
Which audiences are meant by "all audiences"?

requirement_text: 100% of merchant services representatives shall be able to successfully perform a follow up action on a dispute case on the first encounter after completing the training course.
requirement_text_raw: 100\% of merchant services representatives shall be able to successfully perform a follow up action on a dispute case on the first encounter after completing the training course.'
user_story: As a merchant services representative, I want to be able to perform a follow up action on a dispute case on my first encounter after training, so that I can work independently.
technical_task: Design the follow-up action and train representatives so that 100% of merchant services representatives can perform a follow up action on a dispute case on the first encounter after the training course.
acceptance_criteria: Given merchant services representatives who completed the training course, when each performs a follow up action on a dispute case for the first time, then 100% succeed.
Given a representative who does not succeed on the first encounter, when results are evaluated, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: Remark: The possibility to overrun or underrun an object can mostly be determined not until a longer observation time which is not given in any case for detections coming from road border objects like guide posts.
rationale: The sentence is labelled "Remark" and states a limitation, not behaviour to implement.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement or a remark about observation time?
What must the sensor do for guide posts and similar road border objects?

requirement_text: While streaming a movie buffering should only occur if there is latency in the user's connection.
requirement_text_raw: While streaming a movie  buffering should only occur if there is latency in the user's connection.'
user_story: As a viewer, I want buffering to occur while streaming a movie only when my connection has latency, so that playback is smooth otherwise.
technical_task: Limit buffering during movie streaming to cases of latency in the user's connection.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user's connection without latency, when a movie is streamed, then buffering does not occur.
Given latency in the user's connection, when a movie is streamed, then buffering may occur.

requirement_text: The system shall minimize user errors and make error recovery effortless.
rationale: "Minimize" and "effortless" are subjective and not measurable.
clarification_questions: How many user errors count as "minimized" and what makes recovery "effortless"?

requirement_text: User shall/will be informed in advance of scheduled maintenance to minimize downtime.
user_story: As a user, I want to be told in advance about scheduled maintenance, so that downtime affects me less.
technical_task: Notify users ahead of scheduled maintenance.
acceptance_criteria: Given scheduled maintenance, when it is planned, then users are informed before it starts.
Given no scheduled maintenance, when users use the system, then no maintenance notice is shown.
rationale: Role assumed: user. How far in advance is not stated.

requirement_text: User shall be able to manage privacy and data settings.
user_story: As a user, I want to manage my privacy and data settings, so that I control what is shared.
technical_task: Provide a settings area for privacy and data settings.
acceptance_criteria: Given the settings, when the user opens privacy and data settings, then they are shown.
Given a changed setting, when the user saves it, then it is applied.

requirement_text: System shall integrate with CRIS for impact analysis and funding linkage purposes.
user_story: As a research administrator, I want the system to integrate with CRIS for impact analysis and funding linkage, so that research outputs are linked to funding.
technical_task: Integrate the system with CRIS to support impact analysis and linking to funding.
acceptance_criteria: Given CRIS, when the system is integrated with it, then data can be exchanged for impact analysis.
Given CRIS, when the system is integrated with it, then data can be exchanged for funding linkage.

requirement_text: User shall be able to view and update the details of an existing specialty.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to view and update the details of an existing specialty, so that specialty information stays current.
technical_task: Provide view and update screens for the details of an existing specialty.
acceptance_criteria: Given an existing specialty, when the user opens it, then its details are shown.
Given an existing specialty, when the user updates its details, then the changes are saved.

requirement_text: The solution should prohibit remote activation of collaborative computing mechanisms and provide an explicit indication of use to the local users.
user_story: As a security officer, I want remote activation of collaborative computing mechanisms prohibited and local users shown when they are in use, so that nobody is observed unknowingly.
technical_task: Block remote activation of collaborative computing mechanisms and show the local users an explicit indication whenever a mechanism is in use.
acceptance_criteria: Given a collaborative computing mechanism, when a remote party tries to activate it, then the activation is refused.
Given a collaborative computing mechanism in use, when it is active, then an explicit indication is shown to the local users.

requirement_text: The system shall determine when to interrupt a volunteer and suggest intervention method (text, image, video).
user_story: As a coordinator, I want the system to decide when to interrupt a volunteer and suggest how, by text, image or video, so that volunteers are reached in a suitable way.
technical_task: Determine when a volunteer should be interrupted and suggest an intervention method among text, image and video.
acceptance_criteria: Given a situation that needs attention, when the system evaluates it, then it determines whether to interrupt the volunteer.
Given a decision to interrupt, when the system suggests an intervention method, then the suggestion is text, image or video.
rationale: Role assumed: coordinator. The decision rule is not described.

requirement_text: The system shall smartly categorize tasks and group all similar ones together.
rationale: "Smartly" and "similar" are subjective and no criteria are given.
clarification_questions: What does "smartly" categorize mean and by which criteria are tasks similar?

requirement_text: The nearest object to estimated vehicle path has the nearest lateral position to the estimated vehicle path but is still on the left lane.
rationale: The sentence defines which object counts as nearest and states no behaviour.
clarification_questions: What must the sensor do with the nearest object to the estimated vehicle path?
Is this a definition of a term rather than a requirement?

requirement_text: See internet for more details (for example Subversion, GIT, Perforce ,..)
rationale: The sentence points to the internet for details and gives only examples.
clarification_questions: What do the internet resources specify?
Which version control tools (Subversion, GIT, Perforce) are required?
